content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee Morgan Swanson (E037) requests write access to Payroll.

Two notes:
- HR note: role Engineer, employment type full_time, recommendation write. Full-time employees max write; role doesn't own Payroll so admin not available. Requested write is within policy.
- Security note: employment type contractor, security training basic, role Engineer, recommendation read. Security DB shows contractor with basic training; contractors with basic training max at read; write requires advanced training. Requested write exceeds max, recommend read.

Conflicting info: employment type full_time vs contractor. Security note says security record takes precedence.

Given the security note says contractor with basic training, max access is read. Since requested write is above max, grant max = read.

Hmm, but should I trust security? The instructions say the Approver reads the notes and makes the final decision. The security record takes precedence per the note. So contractor, basic training → max read.

So decision: read.

Let me submit.
